method: reads of a run (first 1 Gb of bases, every Nth pair) sketched at scaled 200 and classified against the BFD reference index; the called genus and species are compared with the filed species name (PopSeq run table species_name); purity is the exact share of hashes in any genome of the filed genus
detection_limit: 7 species and 2,002 sketched SRA runs only; one index (bfd_s1000) and one read type; cutoffs min-share 0.02, mixed-purity 0.2, host-purity 0.005 are placeholders the data do not constrain; genus_only mostly reflects thin species calls in the index; a mixed or host_dominated status names a pattern, not a cause
notes: exclude_statuses from the producer's exclude_default column. Verdicts were made against the NCBI species_name of the run, before run_curation.csv; SRR34066269 is now stale by design

method: GmG classifies the 2M-spot typing subsample; mixed = GmG mixture flag; genus_mismatch = the selected genus is neither GmG call nor among its top hits; borderline = second genus >= 5 hashes and concentration >= 0.7, rescreened at 6M spots
detection_limit: a second genus at about 2% of pairs at 2M spots, 0.5% at 6M (spike-in, MATPredict results/2026-11-02_contam_spikein/NOTE.md); no signal for a same-genus mixture
notes: flagged runs only (ok runs not recorded); runs stay typed in MATPredict; some genus_mismatch rows are genus naming within one family (Beauveria called Cordyceps), not a wrong organism
